steps.do: Documents tab → File(s): pick an RFQ PDF, What is it? "Requirement / RFQ", Note "Rev B" → "Attach".

steps.observed: "1 file(s) attached." Listed: 📄 RFQ-TB-Cement.pdf Requirement / RFQ from the customer Rev B 15 Nov 2026 Test MktExec ✕

steps.do: Attach a 10 MB file (the limit is 8 MB per file).
steps.expect: Refused with a message naming the 8 MB limit; nothing half-saved.
steps.observed: Refused: "3 file(s) attached. | Nothing has been saved — File(s) still needs filling in. | That file is too large (10.0 MB) — the limit is 8 MB. Choose a smaller file or compress it."; nothing saved.

steps.expect: It should be refused as a file type not allowed — record what happens.
steps.observed: Refused: ""setup.exe" is a program file. Attach a document or a picture instead. Nothing else on the form was saved either — please attach a different file and submit again."

steps.do: Make a quotation from this lead ("+ Make a quotation") and save it.
steps.expect: The quotation's History says "N file(s) carried over from the lead" and the files are on the quotation.
steps.observed: Q-00001 History: "4 file(s) carried over from the lead"; 4 files are on the quotation.

steps.do: Back on the lead, press ✕ on a file.
steps.expect: The file is removed after confirmation.
steps.observed: Asked "Remove this file?", then "Attachment removed."; BOQ.csv is gone.
